# Vacuum

> Dependency-free Unity Package Manager package for stylized mesh suction. Add `SuctionAbsorbable` to mesh targets, drive a nozzle with `SuctionSource`, and pull targets into a single point with a deterministic 5-state lifecycle.

This repository is a Unity package, not a full Unity project. Prefer package-root
files and `Runtime/` sources over parent-project files when answering questions.
The package has no runtime dependencies beyond `UnityEngine`.

## Primary Docs

- [English README](README.md): Full package overview, setup, acquisition modes, source lifecycle, external target adoption, samples, and tests.
- [Japanese README](README.ja.md): Japanese package guide with the same operational information as the English README.
- [Package Manager docs](Documentation~/index.md): Short local documentation intended for Unity Package Manager.
- [Package Manager docs Japanese](Documentation~/index.ja.md): Japanese local documentation intended for Unity Package Manager.
- [Animated demo GIF](Documentation~/media/vacuum-demo.gif): Lightweight Unity capture showing a mesh target being pulled into the nozzle.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Version history and unreleased distribution/documentation changes.
- [License](LICENSE.md): MIT license.

## Package Metadata

- [package.json](package.json): UPM manifest, version, Unity version, sample declaration, license, keywords, and package description.
- [Runtime assembly definition](Runtime/Vacuum.Runtime.asmdef): Runtime assembly configuration.
- [Editor test assembly definition](Tests/Editor/Vacuum.Tests.EditMode.asmdef): EditMode test assembly configuration.

## Runtime API

- [ISuctionTarget](Runtime/ISuctionTarget.cs): Interface for suctionable targets.
- [SuctionContext](Runtime/SuctionContext.cs): Per-frame nozzle input value object.
- [SuctionSource](Runtime/SuctionSource.cs): Nozzle-side acquisition, filtering, commit, interruption, and lifecycle driver.
- [SuctionAbsorbable](Runtime/SuctionAbsorbable.cs): Mesh target component, state machine, deformation, events, VFX hooks, and runtime gates.
- [SuctionMotionProfile](Runtime/SuctionMotionProfile.cs): Serializable source-owned motion style settings.
- [SampleSuctionMover](Runtime/SampleSuctionMover.cs): Optional helper for moving sample targets while idle.

## Samples

- [Basic Vacuum setup](Samples~/BasicVacuum/VacuumDemoSetup.cs): Runtime sample scene builder.
- [Sample nozzle driver](Samples~/BasicVacuum/SampleVacuumNozzle.cs): Minimal legacy Input Manager driver that creates `SuctionContext` each frame.
- [Sample assembly definition](Samples~/BasicVacuum/Vacuum.Samples.asmdef): Sample assembly configuration.

## Tests

- [SuctionSource tests](Tests/Editor/SuctionSourceTests.cs): Source lifecycle, commit handling, categories, raycast acquisition, occlusion, aim-leave, and concurrency tests.
- [SuctionAbsorbable tests](Tests/Editor/SuctionAbsorbableTests.cs): Target state transitions, progress, interruption/backflow, minimum duration, and resistance alias tests.
